description: Write an FAQ suggestion's question/answer into the voice agent's attached knowledge base as a new document, and mark the suggestion added. Requires the OWNER or ADMIN role. Fails with 409 if the suggestion was already added or dismissed, or if the agent has no knowledge base collection to write into.
